notes: Text comes from the strings the harness rendered each page from (the same constants the view reads), not from a widget tree or OCR, so this reports SCREEN PARITY only. It does not measure keyboard navigation, compositor rendering, or that the frontend launches under its real desktop — those stay the VM walkthrough's job.
